pages.text: The Geiger Counter measures $(l:nuclear/radiation)radiation$(/l). Carry it to know when a place is safe and when to put on a $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Hazmat Suit$(/l).

$(li)Hold it in $(l)either hand$().$(br)$(li)It $(l)clicks$() faster the more radiation there is.$(br)$(li)It shows the level in $(l)Rad$() above the hotbar.$(br)$(li)A $(l:basics/muffler)Muffler$(/l) never silences it.$(br)$(li)$(l)below 20 Rad$(): green, $(o)Safe$()$(br)$(li)$(l)20 Rad and more$(): orange, $(o)Radiation sickness$()
pages.title: Using it

pages.text: $(li)$(l)100 Rad and more$(): red, $(o)DANGER$()$(br)The Neural Chip's $(l)Geiger HUD$() program shows the same reading without a counter in hand: see $(l:trinkets/trinkets)Trinkets$(/l).
